name: Radiant Hookback
description: Stand light and poised with the halberd raised like a hawk's wing before it folds into the stoop.

name: Heaveruin
description: Cut the axe edge in a sweeping curve that follows the line of a hawk's outstretched wing.

name: Berserk Tailstop
description: Thrust the spear point down and forward like a claw closing on prey below.

name: Strangling Crownspike
description: Hook the opponent and haul upward and back so that their weight rises off their feet.

name: Blazehaft
description: Fan the axe edge through a wide arc like spreading pinions to clear everyone near the hawk.

name: Murk Haft
description: Beat aside an incoming blow with the flat of the haft as a hawk beats aside a lesser bird.

name: Ferocious Langet
description: Rise with gathered qi and stoop in a plunging axe blow that splits shield helm and bone.

name: Snatchglare
description: Ride a burst of qi up in a high leap and chop down from above the opponent's guard.

name: Granite Axefall
description: Vanish in a flash of qi above the foe and cleave the axe down along the line the hawk left.

name: Vital Socketring
description: Hold the halberd so that attack and answer each have a court of their own across the body.

name: Eviscerating Spike
description: Chop down from the left court with the axe blade at the opponent's shoulder.

name: Axeblade Ruin
description: Thrust from the right court with the spear point along the line of the opponent's arm.

name: Axeheel Hardihood
description: Parry with the haft across the center line where the two courts meet.

name: Spikefall Nerve
description: Hook in one court and cut in the other so the pull and the blow arrive in one beat.

name: Tempered Drag
description: Answer a cut in the opposite court with a spike thrust that finds the gap it opened.

name: Spikeglare
description: Weave from one court to the other with two steps that keep the halberd head between you and the foe.

name: Lacerating Snatch
description: Sweep the axe through both courts in a single arc that no single guard can cover.

name: Beak Durance
description: Hold the haft in both courts at once with qi along it so two attackers meet one firm guard.

name: Mightheave
description: Cut in one court and thrust in the other in the same instant so that both blows decide the exchange.

name: Beak Respite
description: Stand wide with the halberd covering the full width of the basin in front of the body.

name: Granite Axeblade
description: Chop at the rim of the opponent's reach from the far end of the halberd's span.

name: Novalanget
description: Thrust at the rim of the opponent's reach so the point lands before they can set a guard.

name: Inexorable Socketring
description: Hold the haft across the full width of the body to guard the span from the foe's blows.

name: Mightdrag
description: Cross the basin floor in a few long paces that keep the halberd head always toward the foe.

name: Enthralling Drag
description: Reach wide across the basin to hook and hold an opponent who stands at the far rim.

name: Slaghaft
description: Sweep the axe edge low across the basin floor to cut the legs of those nearest the halberd.

name: Glint Hookback
description: Reply to an attack from the rim with a spike thrust that rides the incoming blow back to its source.

name: Sanguine Heave
description: Cleave outward with qi spilling from the edge so the blow carries past the target and into those behind.

name: Heave Valor
description: Hold the beak's qi field wide across the basin to snare any who cross it and keep them there.

name: Ferocious Tailstop
description: Flash across the whole width of the basin in one bound and drive the spear point home at its far side.

name: Daybreak Crownspike
description: Stand with qi running in two channels down the haft toward the axe head and the spike.

name: Ironlanget
description: Cut upward against the opponent's guard as one drives against a current and breaks its force.

name: Iron Axefall
description: Thrust forward and down with the whole body riding the line as a boat rides a current.

name: Murk Axeheel
description: Slip the haft in a small circle against an incoming blow and let it spend its force in the eddy.

name: Silt Langet
description: Shift the feet from one current to the other to keep the angle of the strike open.

name: Chime Hookpull
description: Hook the lower leg and pull with the hidden force of an undertow that drags the foe down.

name: Granite Spikefall
description: Chop across the opponent's line of force so their own push is turned against them.

name: Indomitable Haft
description: Meet a blow with the haft so that it divides into two currents that pass either side of the body.

name: Nova Hookpull
description: Rush forward with a quick string of thrusts like water breaking over rocks in rapids.

name: Tempered Spike
description: Fall from a height with the axe like a waterfall landing on the stones below.

name: Hoarfrost Spike
description: Bring both currents of qi together at the beak to lock an opponent's weapon where it stands.

name: Merciless Crownspike Havoc
description: Loose both currents of qi through one stroke that breaks the guard and holds the foe pressed down.

name: Axeblade Vitality
description: Stand with weight on the toes and the halberd high so a climb or a stoop starts at once.

name: Unsparing Snatch
description: Cut upward with the axe edge as the body rises to catch the opponent's guard from below.

name: Tempered Haft
description: Drop low and thrust the spear point forward and down at the opponent's belly.

name: Equipoise Hookback
description: Turn the haft up and over an incoming blow as the body climbs out of its line.

name: Thorn Axefall
description: Stoop and seize the opponent's lead leg with the beak and hold it fast.

name: Silt Axeheel
description: Rise with the axe in a wide arc that clears those who crowd the low line.

name: Haftmettle
description: Hook the opponent's belt and lift as the body climbs to pull their weight off the ground.

name: Booming Spikefall
description: Climb a step then fall with a qi-loaded axe cleave that splits the guard.

name: Tempered Snatch
description: Gather qi and stoop along a steep line so the spear point skewers through armor.

name: Beakhavoc
description: Flash upward past the guard in a streak of qi and cleave down from above.

name: Beak Vigil
description: Stand with two courts of attack open beneath the sky and the halberd between them.

name: Blistering Langet
description: Let the axe fall from the high court onto the opponent's shoulder.

name: Decimating Tailstop
description: Dart the spear point from the low court at the opponent's hand or knee.

name: Toxin Langet
description: Hook with the beak in one court while the haft shoves in the other to topple the foe.

name: Heave Reckoning
description: Wheel the axe around both courts in a ring that holds off every side.

name: Equipoise Socketring
description: Slip the haft from one court to the other so a blow is answered by the second court.

name: Granite Hookpull
description: Cleave through both courts in a single qi-driven stroke that no one guard can meet.

name: Tailstop Valor
description: Wheel the halberd overhead in a ring of qi that guards both courts from above.

name: Grievous Snatch
description: Open both courts at once with a cut and a thrust that lets the stroke through to the body.

name: Axeblade Respite
description: Stand low and wide as if the river is rising round the feet and the halberd is raised above it.

name: Might Socketring
description: Cut with an axe stroke that rises with each count like water climbing a bank.

name: Haftruin
description: Thrust the spear point with the full weight of a swollen river behind the shoulder.

name: Unassailable Crownspike
description: Hold the haft low and firm like a levee so that blows spend themselves against it.

name: Haftflash
description: Shift the feet across the wide floodplain in long steps that keep the halberd level.

name: Gyve Hookback
description: Hook the foe and drag them off their footing like a bank washed out by the current.

name: Blaze Drag
description: Sweep the axe low and kick up dust so those near the blade lose their footing.

name: Gust Axeheel
description: Guide a blow along the haft and out over the end like water over a spillway.

name: Might Axefall
description: Cleave with a flood crest of qi behind the axe so the blow overwhelms the guard.

name: Fastening Spikefall
description: Lock the opponent's weapon under the beak with a torrent of qi that will not let go.

name: Irondrag
description: Loose a flood of qi through one sweeping stroke that fills the basin before the halberd.

name: Illuminating Spike
description: Stand with the halberd held high and the eyes down the line of the river.

name: Granite Beak
description: Cut with a flashing axe stroke that catches the light like a glint on moving water.

name: Lacerating Hookpull
description: Dart the spear point from above where the hawk's shadow falls on the opponent.

name: Flintlike Beak
description: Turn the haft along the bank of an incoming blow and send it past into the water.

name: Gustspike
description: Skim across the ground in light quick paces like a hawk low over the water.

name: Mayhemheave
description: Snatch the opponent's weapon or belt with the beak in one quick pass.

name: Vengeful Heave
description: Sweep the axe in a wide spreading arc like a river widening at its mouth.

name: Equipoise Tailstop
description: Brush an incoming blow aside with the haft as a hawk brushes past a branch.

name: Haft Reckoning
description: Climb the line with a thrust that rises against the opponent's guard like a salmon upstream.

name: Decimating Socketring
description: Stoop on the axe stroke and strike through the current of the opponent's guard.

name: Snatchmettle
description: Anchor the beak in the opponent's gear and hold it as a hawk holds its prey.

name: Devastating Hookback
description: Stoop on the foe with qi and cut while the beak binds their weapon fast to the stroke.

name: Prescient Crownspike
description: Stand square on open ground with the halberd out front where nothing gives cover.

name: Unsparing Drag
description: Hew with the axe in a wide stroke that uses the full open space of the plateau.

name: Hellish Spikefall
description: Run in a straight line with the spear point leading and the wind at the back.

name: Spike Valor
description: Turn the haft into the wind to turn a blow aside and give the gust nothing to catch.

name: Spikeblink
description: Take long paces across open ground to keep the foe at the edge of the halberd's reach.

name: Chime Axeblade
description: Hook the foe as the edge wind gusts and pull so that wind and arm throw them together.

name: Merciless Axeheel
description: Sweep the axe low over open ground to cut at any who rush in from several sides.

name: Unconquered Spike
description: Slide the haft along the held bearing to carry a blow wide of the body.

name: Glint Drag
description: Thrust with the wind behind the point so that the strike lands faster than it should.

name: Langetruin
description: Cleave in time with a plateau gust so wind and qi together drive the axe through the guard.

name: Novaspike
description: Gather qi and loose one long thrust along the gale's line that skewers through armor.

name: Flintlike Tailstop
description: Hold the haft upwind of the body with qi along it so the wind itself braces against the blows.

name: Merciless Hookpull Reckoning
description: Spin the halberd on the open plateau and loose a sweeping stroke that no fixed guard can stop.

name: Intent Haft
description: Stand along the sworn bearing with the halberd laid on the same line as the stance.

name: Snatchwrath
description: Chop down along the held bearing so that the blow does not drift in the wind.

name: Spikewrath
description: Thrust along the held bearing with the point steady against every gust.

name: Iron Hookback
description: Hold the haft along the bearing so every blow must cross the line to reach the body.

name: Rumble Axefall
description: Hook with the beak and pull in the direction the gale blows to overturn the foe.

name: Silt Haft
description: Shift the bearing mid-swing and sweep the axe around to catch those who read the first line.

name: Gust Heave
description: Glide along the sworn bearing in a few smooth paces that hold the line against the wind.

name: Devastating Hookpull
description: Fall along the bearing with the gale at the shoulder and the axe edge ahead of the wind.

name: Thorn Langet
description: Spin the sworn halberd so the gale itself forms a screen that turns every blow aside.

name: Titanic Snatch Havoc
description: Loose the full gale along the sworn bearing in one sweep that reaps everything on that line.

name: Crownspike Premonition
description: Stand with no fixed cover and the halberd free to move on every side of the body.

name: Spikehavoc
description: Chop from the open field in a swing that moves with the wind and not against it.

name: Axeheel Ruin
description: Thrust across open ground in a long line that the opponent cannot step around.

name: Thornspike
description: Hook an opponent and drag them along the wind as the oath binds a sworn fighter to the line.

name: Slagspike
description: Sweep the axe in a wide wind-borne arc that clears the open ground in front of the body.

name: Evergreen Socketring
description: Turn aside a blow by moving with it rather than standing in its path.

name: Blaze Axefall
description: Fall with the sworn wind behind the axe and cleave through guard and armor together.

name: Drag Havoc
description: Rush forward on the wind with the spear point leading and drive it clean through the guard.

name: Novasnatch
description: Loose a single stroke across the open field that thrusts and sweeps and leaves no cover standing.

name: Energizing Beak
description: Stand with the sworn breath matched to the wind and the halberd carried easily in both hands.

name: Might Axeblade
description: Drop the axe blade on the wind's downbeat so its weight and the gust arrive as one.

name: Snatchruin
description: Dart the spear point out on the wind with a swift flick of both wrists.

name: Chime Beak
description: Catch an incoming blow on the haft and let the wind carry it past the sworn fighter.

name: Gustsnatch
description: Step along the oath's bearing to a new angle without leaving the line the wind has set.

name: Heave Nerve
description: Hook a weapon with the beak and wrench in the wind's direction to tear it from the hand.

name: Dismantling Spikefall
description: Sweep a wide oath-bound arc of the axe that keeps all foes at the edge of reach.

name: Fastening Snatch
description: Press the beak against a shield or arm and hold it as steadily as the wind holds a banner.

name: Langetwrath
description: Cleave down with the whole gale sworn into the edge so that the stroke splits whatever it meets.

name: Tempered Axeblade
description: Hold the sworn bearing unbroken and loose a long lancing thrust that nothing on the line can turn.

name: Beakwrath
description: Flash upward on the wind and cleave down from the open sky along the sworn line.

name: Vital Axeheel
description: Stand along a bearing freshly taken from the wind with the halberd laid on that line.

name: Dragwrath
description: Let the axe fall along the taken bearing so the blow lands where the line ends.

name: Dragruin
description: Dart the spear point along the taken bearing in one short unwavering thrust.

name: Heavemettle
description: Hook a weapon and pull it off its bearing so the foe loses their line.

name: Mayhemhaft
description: Sweep the axe edge along the taken line to clear those caught upon it.

name: Murk Crownspike
description: Parry a blow while the feet hold the bearing and the wind keeps the haft steady.

name: Haft Wrath
description: Fall along the bearing and split the guard in a single stroke with qi in the edge.

name: Aegis Spike
description: Hold the haft along the bearing so wind and qi together guard against blows from the front.

name: Haftscourge
description: Flash along the taken bearing on the gale and cut down the foe at its end.

name: Healing Tailstop
description: Stand side-on to a gale that blows across the line of attack with the halberd angled into it.

name: Heavehavoc
description: Hew with the axe so that the crosswind pushes the blade onto its mark.

name: Snatchscourge
description: Thrust the point slightly upwind so the crosswind carries it into the target.

name: Impervious Langet
description: Slide the haft down an incoming blade and let the crosswind carry it off to one side.

name: Toxin Spikefall
description: Hook a limb and fling it across with the wind to throw the foe off balance.

name: Slag Socketring
description: Sweep the axe with the side gale to carry the arc farther than the arm alone.

name: Silt Axefall
description: Slip sideways with the crosswind to leave the line of an attack and return behind it.

name: Mightspike
description: Split the guard with an axe stroke that crosses the line of the foe's own attack.

name: Eviscerating Langet
description: Gather qi and rush at an angle to the wind with the spear point piercing through the guard.

name: Eviscerating Granite Snatch
description: Flash across the wind and cut the foe from the side where no guard has been set.

name: Energizing Axeheel
description: Stand with the halberd carried easily across both arms as on a long march over open ground.

name: Gusthaft
description: Hew with the axe at the end of a running step so the pace adds to the blow.

name: Rumble Axeblade
description: Dart the point out at the end of a running pace with the wind at the back.

name: Impervious Hookback
description: Hold the haft across the front while moving so no blow reaches the body between paces.

name: Dazzling Drag
description: Take long even paces over the open ground that cost little breath and keep the head level.

name: Maiming Axefall
description: Hook a weapon at the far edge of reach and wrench it from the hand.

name: Mayhem Spikefall
description: Sweep a long wind-borne arc with the axe that holds off foes on the open ground.

name: Invincible Spike
description: Slide the haft out to meet a blow far from the body and send it wide.

name: Beakscourge
description: Lance the spear point forward at the end of a run in one long reaching thrust.

name: Decimating Heave
description: Cleave with the long gale behind the axe so the stroke splits guard and armor.

name: Ruinous Hookpull
description: Gather qi and drive the spear point in one skewering thrust along the length of the plateau wind.

name: Ponderous Snatch
description: Bind a weapon with the beak and hold it with qi as the wind holds a banner.

name: Tailstop Ruin
description: Loose the whole plateau wind through a single long stroke that cuts and sweeps the way ahead.

name: Daybreak Beak
description: Stand with the halberd lifted toward a wide empty sky and the feet planted on bare ground.

name: Grievous Haft
description: Drop the axe from high overhead with the open sky behind it.

name: Hookpull Ruin
description: Dart the spear point out in a short stab that meets nothing on the way to its mark.

name: Socketring Spine
description: Turn the haft and let a blow slide up and away into the open sky.

name: Gust Hookback
description: Pace in a wide loose circle with the halberd pointing outward at every step.

name: Hoarfrost Crownspike
description: Hook the opponent's weapon high in the air and hold it from rising or falling.

name: Spikeruin
description: Fan the axe through a broad arc under the open sky to keep every side at bay.

name: Impervious Spike
description: Hold the haft against the sky's open line and turn aside any blow that follows it.

name: Hafthavoc
description: Fall from the open sky with qi in the edge and split guard and armor in one cleave.

name: Devastating Socketring
description: Gather qi overhead and loose it down the spear point in a lancing fall through the guard.

name: Berserk Iron Axeblade
description: Loose a sweeping stroke under the open sky that reaps every foe within the halberd's long reach.
